name: Dearest Colara,
label: Quest
description: Dearest Colara,: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: How to describe her beauty? Thousands of years of words and I am at a loss.
These mortals confound the mind and leave us babbling fools.
I've stared at these words too long. No more eloquent meaning can I squeeze from them. No, she must have it now, or some other suitor will surely steal her eye.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Hello there, handsome. Something I can help you with?

clips.title: Completion
paras: I've never received something like this before. How lovely!
